say:2:1230405001:1.text: Do they do anything else other than steal from our village?
say:2:1230405001:1.source_cn: 除了和之前一样抢掠我们的村子，他们还会做其他的吗？
say:2:1230405001:1.male: Do they do anything else other than steal from our village?
say:2:1230405001:1.female: Do they do anything else other than steal from our village?

say:3:1230405002:1.text: They are as nasty as those rats in the sewer!
say:3:1230405002:1.source_cn: 简直就和下水道里的老鼠一样讨厌！
say:3:1230405002:1.male: They are as nasty as those rats in the sewer!
say:3:1230405002:1.female: They are as nasty as those rats in the sewer!

say:4:1230405003:1.text: Mother, please calm down. Your wound has reopened again!
say:4:1230405003:1.source_cn: 母亲，不要再生气了，伤口又裂开了！

say:5:1230405004:1.text: Bandage it up for me! If they come back after I've recovered, I'll surely teach them a lesson!
say:5:1230405004:1.source_cn: 替我包好！等我伤好了，他们要是再来，我非得给他们点颜色看看！
